import numpy as np

# Generate the sets
rng = np.random.RandomState(53)
n_elements = 60
n_sets = 120
sets = []
for i in range(n_sets):
    size = rng.randint(5, 16)
    elements = sorted(rng.choice(n_elements, size, replace=False).tolist())
    cost = rng.randint(1, 20)
    sets.append((elements, cost))

# Generate visible elements (dev evaluator subset)
visible_rng = np.random.RandomState(71)
visible_elements = set(sorted(visible_rng.choice(60, 48, replace=False).tolist()))

# Greedy set cover algorithm
selected = [0] * 120
covered = set()
total_cost = 0

while len(covered) < 60:  # Need to cover ALL elements
    best_ratio = float('inf')
    best_set = -1
    
    for i in range(120):
        if selected[i] == 1:
            continue
            
        elements, cost = sets[i]
        new_elements = set(elements) - covered
        
        if len(new_elements) > 0:
            ratio = cost / len(new_elements)
            if ratio < best_ratio:
                best_ratio = ratio
                best_set = i
    
    if best_set == -1:
        break
        
    selected[best_set] = 1
    covered.update(sets[best_set][0])
    total_cost += sets[best_set][1]
```
